scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact cardinal-interpolation recurrence, exact monodromy and positive-coefficient Schur certificates, with an exact limiting expansion.
scientific_integrity.verification: Standalone symbolic/numerical checker reproduced; finite samples are not treated as an all-triples proof.

scientific_limitations: Proves fixed-three-periodic zero stability for y'=0, not a bound uniform in changing step-ratio patterns.
Does not establish stability on arbitrary grids or nonlinear/stiff convergence.
An earlier primary variable-step BDF3 specialist article was only partly accessible; historical priority risk persists.
title: Exact Floquet stability of BDF3 on every positive three-periodic grid
